name: Check when addressed access answers locally
step: Check when addressed access answers locally
rationale:
tasks/msp/virtual.lua verifies each config opcode against the firmware's own reply before
answering it from PARAM_READ / PARAM_WRITE. A build without a config catalogue (after step
5 of the firmware's parameter-addressing design, or a firmware that never had one) has no
own reply, so the layer must answer at once, setters included. The harness pins both
policies and the BUILD_ID capability bit that selects them.
